basic_info.description: Welcome to 340 Gold Mine Drive, a prime location offering a luxurious lifestyle! This expansive property features over 2,500 sqft of living space, and boasts 4 spacious bedrooms and 5 modern bathrooms. The updated kitchen and bathrooms, along with new flooring throughout, add a touch of contemporary elegance. Enjoy the large family room, perfect for gatherings, and take in the breathtaking panoramic views from your windows and stunning balcony. Situated close to the Glen Park BART Station, Walter Haas Playground, the Diamond Heights Shopping Center, and the scenic Glen Canyon Trail, convenience and outdoor adventure are at your doorstep. Don't miss the chance to own this exquisite home in a highly sought-after neighborhood - schedule your viewing today!
